prompt:
Subject: Restricted adult material with its contents concealed.

Composition: A librarian places a fully opaque, closed adult-media book in a restricted shelf behind a small age-gate marker. Use only the neutral 18+ age mark, with no cover imagery, classification sentence, nudity, or arousing content.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep everything inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background. Only 18+ on the age-gate marker; no descriptive classification text. No incidental captions, speech balloons, logos or watermark.
For each human: exactly two naturally attached arms and two hands.
en: The librarian shelves concealed pornographic material behind an age restriction marked 18+.
ja: 司書が内容を隠した性的な成人向け資料を、18歳以上の年齢制限がある棚に収めています。
